edits.old: - No personal data in logs, tests, events or prompts: the number and the LINE identifier stay in ACE and are never selected, answered, logged or echoed; test data is synthetic.
edits.new: - Personal data follows Data Classification v5. The number and the LINE identifier (`contact_value`) stay in ACE and are never selected, answered, logged or echoed. `contact_key` (DF-EXT-013) and `person_key` (DF-INT-003) are Confidential indirect identifiers: shown within the role's scope, masked in UAT, and a log carries the id of the read only, never the clear key. `external_ref` (DF-INT-029), `delivery_status` (DF-INT-028), `conduct_check` (DF-INT-012), `consent_given`, `consent_at`, `verified_at` and `failed_count` (DF-EXT-015 to DF-EXT-018) are Confidential customer data: shown within the role's scope, and a log or prompt carries a code or an id only, never the customer value. Test data is synthetic.
